metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: PostgreSQL — Privilege Escalation via SET ROLE
properties.description: Detects PostgreSQL SET ROLE attempts for privilege escalation
properties.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category == "SQLSecurityAuditEvents" | where statement_s contains "postgresql" or action_name_s contains "privilege" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), database_name_s, session_server_principal_name_s | where count_ > 5 // AZ-DB-PG-001
